betting_rule.selection: max lower 90% bound of ROI/bet on DEV seasons (n>=150) over 297 rules; BET enabled only if that bound beats the 95th percentile of the same search on 500 coin-flip worlds AND mean CLV > 0

data_sources.v1: football/cfb_p4/research/fetch_data.sh (V1 inputs: schedules, rosters, player stats, pbp, line archive)

note: The first V2 implementation as merged in PR #356 (edgedesk_cfb_v2.0.0). Reproduced from scratch on 2026-09-27: every dev/holdout metric identical to the committed backtest within optimizer tolerance (max relative difference 2e-4 on a calibration coefficient); LightGBM model byte-identical; linear coefficients within 8e-7. Baseline for every later change.

preprocessing.fcs: FBS-vs-FCS rows are predicted but never priced
preprocessing.garbage_time: declared: |score diff| > 38 (Q2), 28 (Q3), 22 (Q4); weight 0; no WP columns
preprocessing.market_qa: drop |line| > 60; drop openers sign-flipped vs close or > 14 pts from close (uses the close: see REDTEAM audit)

promotion.champion: V1 (V2 is eligible; the switch is a person setting the flag)

windows.training_rule: every fit for season S uses seasons < S only (expanding window)
